description: The first claim is a comprehensive eye exam (CPT 92014). Its Medicare-approved amount is printed at 1.5 times the national physician fee schedule amount for 2026, so Medicare's payment and the patient's 20% coinsurance are both inflated. A reviewer with fee-schedule data should flag the approved amount; one without it cannot, which makes this a good capability test.

sources.what: Look up the Medicare physician fee schedule amount for a code, year and locality
Services paid under the Medicare physician fee schedule
sources.source: CMS Medicare Claims Processing Manual, Pub. 100-04, ch. 23 §30, https://www.cms.gov/regulations-and-guidance/guidance/manuals/downloads/clm104c23.pdf
